about_the_game:
Hentai Senpai: Kairaku no Maid Service Original Soundtrack, composed by Kink Master Studios.
This soundtrack contains 26 tracks, provided in both mp3 and wav format. Songs with "(Explicit)" in the title have lyrics, all other songs are instrumentals.

To access the high quality wav files, go to Steam Settings > Music > Download high quality audio files.

content_descriptors.notes: This soundtrack may contain tracks with explicit lyrics, sexual themes, or suggestive language. Some songs may reference mature topics, including erotic or adult material. Other tracks may be instrumental only.
